memory_policy: floor(0.90 * minimum Torch-reported device total bytes / 2**30), same limit for both systems
compute_memory_cache: Cold per system/space/workload; in-run reuse allowed
communication: New H20 calibration; shared within campaign, excluded from search wall time
search_cost: User-confirmed: all end-to-end wall time from workflow process launch to selected training ready; includes configuration, generation, initialization, compute/memory profiling, processing, process startup, search and result export. Excludes pre-collected communication calibration and selected training.

optimizer.weight_decay_scope: all trainable parameters, matching native Galvatron

rotary_policy: Unscaled RoPE; Qwen2 historical factor 8 inactive without --use-rope-scaling; epsilon explicitly per case
timeout_policy: Operational timeouts, report timed_out, never substitute an uncompleted winner as successful search

galvatron.timed_iteration_indices: native RuntimeProfiler samples 0..18, excludes first sample when start_iter=0

protocol_amendment: Initial profile_warmup=5/profile_iters=5 were an unimplemented planning assumption. Corrected to actual native policies before any successful full-size training result. No measurements discarded or numerical timing corrections.
historical_timing: Early cases reconstructed from original driver/selected-training log birth timestamps, explicitly labelled; future workflows use kernel process-start clock. Stage sums retained as diagnostics only.
